name: Xin
about: Xin is a Chinese given name whose meaning depends on the character used. 新 means 'fresh' or 'new,' while 鑫 conveys wealth and prosperity, and 欣 can express happiness or delight. Used across genders, Xin is a concise and versatile name whose written character gives it its precise cultural meaning.

name: Xue
about: Xue is a Chinese given name whose meaning depends on the character used. 雪 means 'snow,' while 学 means 'study,' 'learning' or 'school.' Used across genders, Xue combines natural imagery with intellectual meaning and demonstrates the importance of Chinese characters in understanding a name.

name: Xing
about: Xing is a Chinese given name that can be written with several characters carrying different meanings. 星 means 'star' or 'planet,' while 兴 can mean 'rise' or 'prosper.' Used across genders, Xing has an especially striking celestial interpretation when written as 星.

name: Xia
about: Xia is a Chinese given name with several possible written forms and meanings. 夏 means 'summer' and can also carry the sense of greatness, while 霞 means 'rosy clouds.' Used across genders, Xia is a compact name connecting seasonal warmth with the colours of the sky.

name: Xun
about: Xun is a Chinese given name with several established character forms. 勋 means 'meritorious deed' or 'rank,' while 迅 means 'fast' or 'sudden.' Used across genders, Xun combines ideas of achievement and movement in a short, distinctive form.

name: Xiang
about: Xiang is a Chinese given name with several established character forms. 翔 means 'soar' or 'glide,' 祥 means 'good luck' or 'good omen,' while 香 means 'fragrant.' 湘 can also refer to the Xiang River in southern China. Used across genders, Xiang offers several distinct interpretations within one established name.

name: Xiaoming
about: Xiaoming is a Chinese given name formed from 晓, meaning 'dawn,' and 明, meaning 'bright,' 'light' or 'clear.' The combination creates an evocative image of daylight arriving after darkness. Used across genders, Xiaoming is a meaningful name centred on light, clarity and new beginnings.

name: Xinyi
about: Xinyi is a Chinese given name that can be formed from several combinations of characters. 欣 can mean 'happy,' 'joyous' or 'delighted,' while 心 means 'heart,' 'mind' or 'soul,' and 怡 means 'joy' or 'harmony.' Used across genders, Xinyi has a warm meaning centred on happiness, inner life and harmony.

name: Xinyan
about: Xinyan is a Chinese given name that can be written using several combinations of characters. One established form uses 欣, meaning 'happy,' 'joyous' or 'delighted,' together with 妍, meaning 'beautiful.' Used across genders, Xinyan combines a sense of happiness with beauty and positive expression.

name: Xiaoping
about: Xiaoping is a Chinese given name that can be formed from several combinations of characters. 小 means 'small,' while 平 means 'level,' 'even' or 'peaceful.' Other character combinations are also possible. Used across genders, Xiaoping carries a gentle sense of simplicity and peace.

name: X
about: X is an ultra-minimal modern given name built around the letter X. As a name it can suggest possibility, mystery, individuality or the unknown, while avoiding an inherently masculine or feminine association. Its use as a contemporary personal name gives it a distinctive place among modern gender-neutral names.

name: Exa
meaning: Modern coined name; associated with exa-, a scientific prefix
about: Exa is a modern given name with a distinctly contemporary and gender-neutral character. It is associated with the scientific prefix exa-, used for an extremely large numerical quantity, giving the name a subtle connection with technology, scale and innovation.

name: Xan
about: Xan is a short, distinctive name used as a form of several longer names including Alexander and Alexandra. Through these connections it carries the traditional meaning associated with Alexander, commonly interpreted as 'defender' or 'defender of people.' Its compact form works naturally as a gender-neutral name.

name: Xen
about: Xen is a modern English name and variant spelling of Zen. Its association with Zen gives it connections to meditation, calmness, simplicity and awareness. Short and visually distinctive, Xen functions naturally as a gender-neutral modern name.

name: Xylo
about: Xylo is a rare modern English name connected with the Greek element xylon, meaning 'wood.' It also evokes the xylophone through its sound and spelling, giving it an indirect association with music and creativity. Its modern construction makes it well suited to gender-neutral naming.

name: Xandy
about: Xandy is a modern English diminutive associated with Alexander and Alexandra. Through those names it carries the traditional meaning 'defender' or 'defender of people.' Its friendly sound and established connections to both masculine and feminine forms make Xandy a natural gender-neutral choice.

name: Xion
about: Xion is a rare modern given name with an intentionally contemporary sound. Its lack of a strongly gendered traditional form allows it to function naturally as a gender-neutral name. Xion offers a distinctive alternative for families looking for a short, unconventional name beginning with X.

name: Xolani
about: Xolani is a Southern African name associated with peace and forgiveness. It is found in Xhosa and related Nguni naming traditions and carries a warm virtue-based meaning. Used across genders, Xolani brings strong South African representation to the collection.
